name: Teleo
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Palo Alto, CA, USA
long_description: Teleo converts heavy equipment, like dozers, trucks, and loaders, into supervised autonomous robots. This enables a single operator to remotely operate multiple machines while sitting at a remote control center, unlocking productivity gains for the General Contractor.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Vinay is the co-founder and CEO of Teleo. Prior to Teleo, he was the Director of Product Management at Lyft working on building Lyft's self-driving cars. Prior to Lyft, Vinay led Product Management at Google Street View, Google Maps, and Google reCAPTCHA launching several consumer products used by millions of users worldwide. Vinay has a Ph.D. in Computer Science, focusing on Computer Vision from the University of Maryland, College Park
